body:
This project uses Forward+ on desktop platforms, but the web platform only supports the Compatibility renderingt method. Therefore, different visuals are expected since Compatibility uses a different dynamic range and blending method for lights with shadows enabled.

Manual tweaks need to be performed on the project's end using scripts that detect the current rendering method to adjust the brightness/colors of certain elements. There is no "one size fits all" solution here, so every project will need to come up with their own tweaks.

If you want 100% consistent visuals across platforms (or rather, as consistent as it can be), switch the project to the Compatibility rendering method and adjust things from there.

See https://github.com/KenneyNL/Starter-Kit-3D-Platformer/issues/24.
